title: Chough timing skips direct-native-write events without marking its report partial (189, DRIVE-21)
description: chough timing skips direct-native-write events without marking its report partial (189, DRIVE-21)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-history-013 (modified): chough timing reads a history holding a direct-native-write event as complete, skipping it as part of no stage segment, with no unrecognised kind and no partial mark; truly unknown kinds still mark the report partial. The new test in tests/direct_writes.rs fails first, a mutation that counts the kind again fails it, and fledge run linux-verify passes.

answers.constraints: Issue #189, regression from #183 (#186, DRIVE-21): timing must not count the valid direct-native-write kind (REQ-history-013) as unrecognised. Truly unknown kinds still mark the report partial. Rule: failing test first; a mutation shows the test real. Lesson: run the spec coverage check locally before Linux verify.
